strings.help.center.quick.title: Quick start
strings.help.center.quick.body:
Platform: Apple Silicon Mac. Keep the entire project folder and double-click Start.command wherever you saved it.
Python 3.9+ and the complete launcher sources are required for the menu. Node.js and compatible game components are required for gameplay, not for browsing help.
First open [3] environment checks. Missing game components allow limited mode; language, appearance, help and local reports remain available.
! Preview provides source code, not a complete FX/FEX/Proton installer. No component is installed by reading this help.
Expected runtime components (from runtime-requirements.json): {components}.
Installation: README.md and docs/AI_INSTALL.md. Run the Python/Node helper from the actual project root; installation requires confirmation.

[3] now opens read-only installation checks and the setup guide. Guest components remain unverified without Guest. The existing SSH-capable runtime check requires an explicit choice. Guidance is stateless and never saves settings. See docs/SETUP.md.
strings.help.center.launch.title: Game launch explained
strings.help.center.launch.body:
[1] rechecks local runtime dependencies and acquires the shared target lock. Missing dependencies cancel the launch, not the menu.
The backend checks FX, starts or connects to it, establishes SSH, verifies Guest identity and checks Steam plus the compatibility environment.
! Guest IPv6, managed Steam proxy settings and complete Steam LaunchOptions may need changes. The launcher presents actual changes for explicit confirmation; refusing cancels launch. Guest sudo is not macOS sudo.
Private backups and bounded recovery cover specific changes. An uncertain SSH outcome or failed recovery requires manual inspection. Full rollback of every launch side effect is not guaranteed.
Stopped Steam can receive one controlled start when no game is active. An active game is not forcibly restarted. Steam receives the HELLDIVERS 2 launch request using the existing FEX/Proton chain.
Progress stages: FX, SSH, Environment, Steam, Game, EAC, PlayFab, UDP. States and elapsed time reflect checks; no guaranteed completion percentage.
EAC considers only bytes observed after the current request's log baseline. Missing, rotated or ambiguous evidence remains unverified.
! A game process is not proof of EAC verification or multiplayer success. Failure does not automatically retry the entire launch. Use [3] checks or [4] report export.
Details: docs/LAUNCH_SAFETY.md.
strings.help.center.performance.title: Performance settings
strings.help.center.performance.body:
Main menu: {performance_name}. Browse M1–M5 families, then an existing chip model, or select automatic detection. Unavailable memory/GPU data is unknown, never guessed.
The catalogue currently contains {profiles} profile(s): {verified} verified, {experimental} experimental. Other chips show no configuration; a chip model does not create a preset.
The historical profile is scoped to M4 Pro with 24 GiB memory. Applying it requires matching hardware, runtime checks, a parameter diff and confirmation. Browsing works in limited mode.
Existing profile parameters: {parameters}.
These are macOS FX UserDefaults. [1] still uses the existing fixed FX launch allocation; browsing or choosing a chip does not dynamically substitute CPU/RAM/GPU arguments.
FX CPU/RAM/GPU allocation changes require a future explicit integration and VM restart. Existing profile application does not stop a running game or VM; it can report that restart is required.
Private receipts are stored in launcher-20261026/backups. Inspect the saved original values before manual recovery; no new one-click restore menu is promised.
Details: docs/PERFORMANCE_MENU.md.
strings.help.center.environment.title: Environment checks
strings.help.center.environment.body:
Launcher prerequisites are Python 3.9+ and required local files/modules. Game requirements include Node.js, SSH, the compatible FX executable and matching network component. Guest FEX/Proton/Steam remain unverified until actually inspected.
Missing local runtime components enter limited mode and block actual launch. Only detected missing items are counted; unknown Guest checks are not invented missing items.
Unchecked means no observation; ready means that specific check passed; abnormal means a detected problem; unverified means insufficient evidence. Local readiness does not prove the game can run.
[3] defaults to stateless Level 1 installation checks, with no SSH or configuration writes. Its guide covers nine setup topics; repeat checks for full evidence or export a new private installation report. Only [3] → [4] after confirmation delegates to the existing SSH-capable Level 2 check. Main-menu [4] remains the existing runtime report and may connect Guest; static reports instead use [3] → [3].
Check Python/Node first, then FX/component locations and versions, then SSH. Documentation: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. Help itself performs no checks or configuration changes.
Setup workflow and evidence limits: docs/SETUP.md. Installed files are skipped; unknown versions are never replaced by the guide.
strings.help.center.network.title: Network and multiplayer diagnostics
strings.help.center.network.body:
[10] provides snapshots, FX/SSH/Steam observations, proxy-port checks, DNS/TCP/HTTPS and PlayFab TLS probes, plus UDP/STUN observations when available.
! An open proxy port does not prove game UDP works. A gvproxy process does not prove NAT mapping. UDP/STUN success is not game matchmaking success or a complete NAT validation.
Absent results stay unknown or unverified. TLS handshake time is not steady game latency.
Record actual matchmaking success or failure manually. History statistics use stored real outcomes; empty history has no invented success rate.
Diagnostics history is in the user Application Support directory. Sanitized export does not intentionally include passwords or tokens; review reports before sharing.
Snapshots and probes do not automatically change proxy nodes, routes, DNS, Wi-Fi or IPv6. Your network can differ from the developer's setup.
strings.help.center.ssh.title: SSH connection settings
strings.help.center.ssh.body:
[8] edits host, SSH port, username, authentication method and local Steam CDP port. Use the endpoint that belongs to your intended FX Guest.
Settings live in the user's Application Support directory (or HD2FX_SETTINGS_FILE override). A connection test checks authentication and Guest Python without launching a game.
Passwords are prompted privately. Saving a password is optional and uses macOS Keychain, not settings.json. Key-based authentication refers to the selected private-key path.
! Do not share passwords, private keys, settings or raw logs. A changed host key requires verifying the target; do not blindly delete known_hosts entries.
An open SSH port alone does not verify the intended FX instance. Launch-time Guest writes require stronger identity checks; uncertain identity blocks writes.
If connection fails, check FX readiness, host/ports, username and authentication. Reading this page does not connect SSH or access Keychain.
strings.help.center.updates.title: Updates and version management
strings.help.center.updates.body:
Launcher version: {version}. VERSION is the only release-version source; UI 2.1 is the interface name.
[11] opens offline. Select [1] to query the official public GitHub Releases API. No GitHub token is needed. The installed channel is the default (Preview for this build). Use [4] to select Preview / Stable for this session, then [1] to check; settings are not saved. Main commits are not releases.
The screen shows current/latest version, publication date and release notes. Use [3] for the local CHANGELOG or [5] to open the official Releases page. No releases is a normal state; timeouts and API errors do not block the menu.
Download/install capability: {update_state}.
! Current updates are read-only. They never replace your SSH settings, Keychain items, language, appearance, performance preferences, network configuration, diagnostic history or custom data.
A future installer must have trusted packages, a reviewed file allowlist and installed-file baseline, refuse local edits, and back up/roll back safely. Those installation guarantees are not yet implemented end to end; installation stays disabled.
Configuration migrations must be separate and explicit. No settings are reset to validate an update. Details: docs/UPDATES.md and docs/USER_DATA.md.
strings.help.center.appearance.title: Language and appearance
strings.help.center.appearance.body:
[7] selects a launcher language; a saved manual choice takes priority over macOS AppleLanguages. Without a saved choice, the first supported system language is used, falling back to English on detection failure.
[9] changes emblem/animation preferences. Use the existing layout option to switch immersive or compact display. Language and appearance are stored locally for later launches.
Only the launcher language changes. Steam/game language and macOS preferences are untouched.
Help content is currently written in Simplified Chinese and English; other supported languages use the existing English fallback where a help translation is missing.
Arrow keys select, Enter confirms, Esc or 0 goes back. Long help pages scroll with arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End. Reading help works offline.
strings.help.center.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
strings.help.center.faq.body:
Why does the menu open without FX?
Limited mode intentionally keeps local UI tools available. Gameplay still needs the compatible runtime.
Why is game launch unavailable?
[1] rechecks dependencies and identity. Missing components, invalid configuration, an active target lock or refused changes stop launch safely. Use [3] for details.
Why does SSH fail?
Check FX readiness, endpoint, ports and authentication in [8]. A port opening alone proves neither login nor Guest identity.
Why did Steam not start?
Recovery is bounded to one safe start. Another active game, unknown identity or a service/CDP error can block it; inspect the reported stage instead of repeatedly launching.
Why is a game process visible but multiplayer fails?
Process, EAC, HTTPS and UDP observations are separate evidence. Check [10] and record the actual match outcome.
Why did a performance setting not take effect?
Most chips have no tested preset. UserDefaults do not replace fixed launch arguments, and allocation changes need a VM restart. Do not terminate an active game for testing.
Why is no update found?
The repository may have no Release in your channel, or the API may be unavailable. A main-branch commit is not an update Release.
Will my settings survive an update?
The current checker performs no installation or migration, so it does not alter settings. Automatic installation remains disabled until its full protection and recovery requirements are verified.

strings.setup.base.body:
Purpose: Python >=3.9 opens the UI. Node >=22 with fetch and WebSocket is needed for Steam control, not local menus.
Official sources and version evidence: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
From the actual project folder:
/bin/bash tools/install_dependencies.sh --check
After your confirmation only:
/bin/bash tools/install_dependencies.sh
Suitable tools are skipped. Without Homebrew only official installation choices are shown. No automatic Homebrew installation.
Then reopen Start.command or repeat checks. If paths/permissions fail, see docs/SETUP.md. No installer is run from this page.
strings.setup.fx.body:
Purpose: run the compatible Guest. FX 1.9.4 is the historical baseline with additional patches, not a universal supported installer.
Official source and blockers: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
The required local executable/hash comes from runtime-requirements.json. An ordinary FX install or another location may not match. Do not reinstall or move an existing working instance just to pass this check.
The exact compatible public package/build recipe is pending. Existing files are skipped; unknown versions are not overwritten. Next: verify local evidence, then arrange Guest validation separately.
strings.setup.fex.body:
Purpose: x86-64 translation inside Guest. The required executable/hash is in runtime-requirements.json. No compatible public installation recipe is verified.
Upstream references: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md; upstream latest is not proof of compatibility.
Guest is not inspected here. FEX is unverified, not missing. Do not replace existing FEX. Next: maintainer-confirmed build provenance and explicitly selected runtime checks. Details: docs/SETUP.md.
strings.setup.proton.body:
Purpose: Windows compatibility inside Guest. Historical Proton-JE baseline and patched Wine hashes are in runtime-requirements.json. No turnkey compatible package is provided.
Upstream references and exact path: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
Guest is uninspected; no absence or compatibility is inferred. Do not overwrite an existing tool. Next: confirm exact patched build, then explicitly validate Guest. Details: docs/SETUP.md.
strings.setup.network.body:
Purpose: virtual-machine networking using the existing gvproxy-eim wrapper. Required hash/path: runtime-requirements.json.
Upstream source and pending EIM build provenance: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. A generic gvproxy binary is not a confirmed replacement.
This preview does not include the binary. No download, proxy, DNS, route, Wi-Fi or IPv6 changes occur here. Existing components are skipped. Next: obtain a maintainer-confirmed matching build, repeat static checks. Network evidence does not prove multiplayer.
strings.setup.steam.body:
Purpose: your own Steam account and HELLDIVERS 2 (553850) inside Guest. Official Steam/game sources: docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.
Guest Python, systemd user service, procfs, taskset and matching graphics/compatibility components are required by the current launch code; versions are not all established.
Sign in and install the game yourself after preparing a compatible Guest. This guide cannot verify them locally or install them.
Next: explicit runtime checks, then use existing [1] Start game for Level 3. Process/EAC/UDP observations do not prove multiplayer success.
strings.setup.ssh.body:
Purpose: access your own Guest. OpenSSH is supplied with macOS; configured host, port, username, authentication and optional Keychain references are kept in the existing settings system.
This page validates only the settings schema; it neither connects nor reads passwords. No saved configuration is rewritten.
Set values using your actual FX instance in [8]; there is no universal password. Connection tests and saves are explicit actions in that existing page.
Unknown host keys or identity mismatches need manual verification. See docs/SETUP.md and docs/USER_DATA.md.

messages.\nInstructions\n1. Use option 1 for norm:
Instructions
1. Use option 1 for normal launches. It preserves your current game launch options.
2. Use option 2 for initial setup or to restore launch options: check the installed FX/FEX/Proton-JE, prepare IPv4, the proxy and Steam networking, then back up and save the verified D3D12 launch options.
   Setup does not start the game. Steam may restart if needed. Setup refuses to run while a game or installation step is active.
   If FX is stopped, it starts with the verified settings. If a running FX uses different settings, quit FX normally before setup.
3. Option 3 checks the environment; 4 exports a report; 5 opens the launcher folder.
4. A component version mismatch requires repair. Setup does not download or replace compatibility tools.
5. If automatic window switching fails, switch to FX manually. Choose Continue for the driver warning.
6. Menu 8 edits SSH settings, tests connections, and saves/removes Keychain passwords. Menu 9 selects an emblem. Initial setup runs only once.
7. Use ↑/↓, Return and Esc, or enter a number and press Return. Optional password storage uses macOS Keychain, never the settings file.
8. On the home screen use Left/Right to switch columns, Tab to cycle, and M to remember immersive/compact mode (80x25 minimum for immersive). Status refreshes every 10 seconds; R refreshes now, 3 runs full checks. Menu 9 → 7 also changes layout. Language is remembered.
